props.name: adapter
props.comment:
The router adapter to inject. Defaults to `reactRouterAdapter`; swap it for
`tanstackRouterAdapter` or a custom adapter (plan D1). Named `router` on
`<Admin>`, `adapter` here (the low-level name).

props.name: authProvider
props.comment: The optional auth provider (gates the shell when `requireAuth`).

props.name: basename
props.comment:
The URL prefix the app is served under (default `''`). When `<Admin>`
creates its router, that router applies it. Under a host router, it is the
path the host mounts `<Admin>` at, relative to the host router's own
basename; Chelone prepends it to the links it builds.

props.name: dataProvider
props.comment: The data provider (required — the P2 data seam).

props.name: queryClient
props.comment: The React Query client (required — factory-created at the app root).

props.name: registry
props.comment:
An existing runtime resource registry. Omit to have the provider create one
(the common case). Supply one to share a registry across trees / for SSR.
The first render of `<Admin>` registers its resources in it, so a listener
already subscribed to a supplied registry is notified during that render:
subscribe after `<Admin>` mounts, or register the resources up front.

props.name: resources
props.comment: The zod resource registry (enables registry-schema form validation).

props.name: store
props.comment: The optional KV store (preferences / list scroll).
